proposals.evidence: Turner manas supplies the regional man mind family. Platts explicitly derives Hindi man from Prakrit maṇo and Sanskrit manas and includes heart among its senses. The surveyed man/mon forms are compared with this family; their elicited heart sense is preserved, without claiming that all varieties distinguish anatomical and emotional senses identically.
